deviations.what: The output key set is taken from firm_year without unique(), so repeated (firm_id, year) rows in firm_year produce repeated output rows instead of being collapsed to one.

notes: All other rules match: filing_year dating, cpc_seq == 0 filter with first_listed_only switch, NA and empty-string classes excluded, 5-year base and 3-year forward windows with year t excluded, anti-join for new classes, and the NA/0 rules. Focal years 1987-2015 are not enforced inside the function and depend on the caller's firm_year, and treating empty-string subclasses as missing is a reasonable reading of the spec.
